text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to remove an accessible parking space on Fraserwood Avenue, east of Shermount Avenue. The accessible permit holder who originally requested the parking space has moved away and the space is no longer required.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing accessible parking space on the north side of Fraserwood Avenue, between a point 55 metres east of Shermount Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further east.
